findings.detail: Non-final naming predicates are rewritten to an ungrammatical `what.` fragment, e.g. `This is known as what. this process needs light.`; preserve a declarative non-final clause and add repeated-definition regression coverage.

Pending SmolLM2 results are not invalidated by every user edit: `updateExplanation` clears undo history without advancing `pasteRequestRef`, so a delayed result can overwrite newer card state. Invalidate on every relevant mutation.

The capture-phase Ctrl+Z handler intercepts every input, textarea, and contentEditable descendant while any snapshot is pending, including explanation and unrelated answer controls; narrow the target so native undo remains available.

Required browser verification is absent for manual/add/edit paste propagation, native fallback, metadata exclusion, stale fallback cancellation, and scoped/native undo; run browser checks or equivalent component event tests.
The recorded full Vitest run remains incomplete because of worker IPC and heap failures; rerun the full suite in a stable resource configuration and document the result separately from task tests.
